name: Knockers fan
source: A socially awkward young woman from Nondescriptville. A baseball fan and a supporter of the Nondescriptville Knockers, with an interest in betting. [spoiler]Wants to bet on the outcome of the match, resulting in Daisy having to run naked across the field if she accepts the terms of the bet. Alternatively becomes good friends with Daisy if she refuses to bet on the game.[/spoiler]
